notes: Registration input, not a run input: Binance spot 1-minute klines for BTCUSDT, one daily zip per UTC day (httpblobs, ADR-0233), reshaped to parquet by crypto_trading.binance_vision:BinanceKlines (epoch ms; the vendor's microsecond files since 2025-01-01 are floored) and laid out <date>.parquet in stream files. BTCUSDT is quoted in USDT, a proxy for, not a copy of, the USD CF Benchmarks BRTI that Kalshi settles on. LICENCE: Binance Vision data is CC BY-NC-SA (https://data.binance.vision/Binance_Vision-Terms_of_Use.pdf): research use only, not for live trading features. Dates: configs/binance_vision_dates.json, pinned by entities_sha256 (export CRYPTO_TRADING_ROOT=<this child's root>; no machine path is stored). The untouched vendor zip is kept at _raw/<date>.zip and its sha256 is the inventory raw_sha256: compare it with the vendor's <file>.zip.CHECKSUM (automatic verification awaits the PROPOSED httpblobs sidecar ADR, see decision-log). max_refused 5: a day Binance lacks lands as a refused inventory row (suite-binance-files.json warns) instead of aborting a pull of over a thousand files. throttle_s 0.1 is polite to a static archive; max_bytes 50 MB is a sanity cap (a daily zip is about 70 KB). A changed declaration (dates, pin or as_of) re-pulls; an unchanged one is a no-op. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source binance-btcusdt-1m --catalog-source binance-btcusdt-1m --connector httpblobs --config @configs/source-binance-btcusdt-1m.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source binance-btcusdt-1m --stream files --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-binance-files.json.
